hook_line: I stayed. Now tell me the truth. What did my father promise you?
why: A confrontation, a betrayal reveal and a 'pay for his crime or help me' ultimatum, ending on a question whose answer is withheld.
script_span:
[INT. MARROW HILL HOUSE - STUDY - NIGHT]
  0:03.00  ELENA ((seething)): "I stayed. Now tell me the truth. What did my father promise you?"
  0:06.80  ADRIAN: "Not a promise. A debt. We built this company together — your father and I, two names on one contract."
  0:11.50  ELENA ((scoffs)): "My father built Voss Holdings alone. Everyone knows that."
  0:14.50  ADRIAN ((turning)): "Everyone knows the story he sold them. On the night of the merger, he had me arrested and signed my half away while I sat in a cell."
  0:19.20  CAMERA: Elena's certainty cracks; she grips the back of a chair.
  0:22.50  ELENA ((whisper)): "You're lying. He would never."
  0:25.50  ADRIAN: "Then explain why your inheritance was mine to take. The will wasn't a gift, Elena. It was a confession."
  0:30.00  SOUND_FX: A long clock in the hall strikes a single, heavy chime.
  0:32.50  ADRIAN ((stepping closer)): "He spent his last breath trying to give back what he stole. The question is whether you'll pay for his crime — or help me finish it."
  0:37.50  ELENA: "Finish what?"

hook_line: "No, Miss Voss. To a man none of you in this room have ever met."
cliffhanger_line: The heavy oak door unlatches with a deep, echoing clunk.
why: It opens on the inheritance twist, builds through the family's shock, and cuts on the door opening just before the stranger appears.
script_span:
[INT. HARLOW & GREY LAW OFFICE - DAY]
  0:11.00  LAWYER: "No, Miss Voss. To a man none of you in this room have ever met."
  0:15.50  CAMERA: Sharp cut to the aunts gasping; Uncle Desmond's wine glass freezes halfway to his lips.
  0:19.00  UNCLE DESMOND ((furious)): "That is absurd. My brother would never hand the Voss name to an outsider."
  0:23.20  ELENA ((quiet, shaking)): "Who is he? What is his name?"
  0:27.00  LAWYER: "He asked to deliver that answer himself. He is already here."
  0:31.50  SOUND_FX: The heavy oak door unlatches with a deep, echoing clunk.
audit_note: Opens mid-answer: 'No, Miss Voss. To a man…' responds to an unheard question, and the viewer doesn't learn it's about the inheritance until Desmond's line around 0:19. The first 3 seconds are a dangling fragment with no clear stakes.

hook_line: Low angle on polished black shoes crossing the threshold; a tall man in a charcoal coat steps into the light.
cliffhanger_line: "You have until midnight to decide whether you walk out that door — or stay and learn why." Cello note, cut to black.
why: It has a full arc: dramatic entrance, a promise to collect, a power reveal and a midnight ultimatum, all ending on a hard cut to black.
script_span:
[INT. HARLOW & GREY LAW OFFICE - CONTINUOUS]
  1:04.00  CAMERA: Low angle on polished black shoes crossing the threshold; the room turns as one. A tall man in a charcoal coat steps into the light.
  1:08.50  ADRIAN ((calm)): "You must be Elena. You have your father's eyes."
  1:12.80  ELENA ((rising)): "I don't know you. Why would he give you my whole life?"
  1:16.00  ADRIAN: "Because thirty years ago your father made a promise. And tonight I have come to collect it."
  1:21.40  UNCLE DESMOND: "Get out before I call security, you fraud."
  1:24.50  ADRIAN ((not turning)): "Security works for me now, Desmond. As of this morning, so do you."
  1:29.00  CAMERA: Push in on Elena, breath held, as Adrian finally meets her gaze.
  1:33.50  ADRIAN ((softly, to Elena)): "The house is mine. Everything is mine. You have until midnight to decide whether you walk out that door — or stay and learn why."
  1:39.00  SOUND_FX: A single low cello note swells and cuts abruptly to black.

arc: Elena vs. the mystery man and her father's promise
hook_line: "No, Miss Voss. To a man none of you in this room have ever met."
why: The door unlatches on the unknown heir, then Elena confronts Adrian over her father's promise. It is a natural escalation, though B's cliffhanger is weaker (c5) and the link between the stranger and Adrian is implied, not confirmed. — A sets up a mystery stranger who is 'already here', and B shows Elena confronting him in the study about her father's promise. The cliffhanger flows into the confrontation and a new viewer can follow it. The only small gap is that Adrian is never named as the stranger in A, which is minor.

hook_line: Tyres scream on gravel; headlights flood the cellar window
cliffhanger_line: "You? It was you the whole time?" — gunshot, smash to black
why: It escalates from arriving threat to a burn-it-down ultimatum, a door opening, a betrayal reveal and a gunshot; the only weakness is thin context.
script_span:
[INT. MARROW HILL HOUSE - CELLAR - NIGHT]
  0:35.50  SOUND_FX: Outside, tyres scream on gravel; headlights flood the cellar window.
  0:39.00  CAMERA: Adrian's head snaps toward the light. His calm is gone.
  0:43.00  ADRIAN ((urgent)): "He came early. Elena — whatever you hear up there, do not open that door."
[INT. MARROW HILL HOUSE - ENTRANCE HALL - CONTINUOUS]
  0:58.00  CAMERA: Elena climbs the cellar stairs against Adrian's warning. Through the frosted glass of the front door, three dark silhouettes stand waiting.
  1:02.50  DESMOND ((through the door, muffled)): "Open up, Elena. Hand me the folder and your inheritance stays yours. I only want him."
  1:07.00  ELENA ((hand on the latch)): "And if I don't?"
  1:10.50  DESMOND: "Then I burn Marrow Hill to the ground with both of you inside it."
  1:14.50  CAMERA: Close on Elena's trembling fingers tightening around the brass latch. Behind her, Adrian reaches the top of the stairs.
  1:18.50  ADRIAN ((sharp)): "Elena, step back —"
  1:20.50  CAMERA: She turns the latch. The door swings inward. The silhouettes raise their hands into the light.
  1:24.50  ELENA ((gasping)): "You? It was you the whole time?"
  1:27.00  SOUND_FX: A gunshot cracks. Smash to black.
audit_note: There is a 15s scripted gap (0:43 to 0:58) that is dead or unaccounted time inside the clip. The 'You? It was you the whole time?' payoff depends entirely on a face-reveal shot the script never identifies. The folder, Desmond and 'him' all assume prior knowledge.

hook_line: A single bulb swings over Elena as the old safe groans open
why: Strong opening image and a sealed-safe reveal, cut off mid-sentence, but Adrian and Desmond are never explained.
script_span:
[INT. MARROW HILL HOUSE - CELLAR - NIGHT]
  0:00.00  CAMERA: A single bulb swings over Elena as she turns the brass key. The old safe groans open. Inside: a slim folder and a photograph.
  0:04.00  ELENA ((reading, voice breaking)): "'In the event of my death, the truth is owed to Adrian Kade first, and to my daughter second.'"
  0:09.00  CAMERA: She lifts the photograph: her father and a young Adrian, laughing, arms around each other's shoulders. On the back, three words.
  0:12.50  ELENA ((whisper)): "'My only brother.'"
  0:15.50  SOUND_FX: A sharp intake of breath echoes off the stone walls.
  0:17.80  ELENA ((reeling)): "Adrian isn't a stranger. He's blood. Desmond isn't my uncle at all —"
audit_note: The reveal ('My only brother' / 'Desmond isn't my uncle') only lands if you already know who Adrian and Desmond are and what they claim to be. To a cold viewer it's a tangle of names and family relations with no anchor.

hook_line: Elena steps into the dark hallway — and freezes. A figure is already there.
cliffhanger_line: Behind her, unseen, Adrian watches from the study doorway — and his jaw tightens.
why: A self-contained scare, key and death threat, ending on a double-cross sting that leaves Adrian's reaction open.
script_span:
[INT. MARROW HILL HOUSE - HALLWAY - CONTINUOUS]
  1:01.00  CAMERA: Elena steps into the dark hallway to breathe — and freezes. A figure is already there, watching from the shadows.
  1:05.00  UNCLE DESMOND ((smiling)): "Careful, niece. A man who claims he owns everything is a man with a great deal to hide."
  1:09.50  ELENA ((guarded)): "How long have you been standing there?"
  1:12.50  UNCLE DESMOND: "Long enough. Whatever he told you, remember — he came back for revenge, not for you."
  1:17.80  CAMERA: Desmond presses a small brass key into Elena's palm and closes her fingers over it.
  1:21.00  UNCLE DESMOND ((low)): "Your father's private safe. What's inside will tell you which of us is the monster. Open it alone."
  1:26.50  ELENA: "And if I show it to Adrian instead?"
  1:29.50  UNCLE DESMOND ((turning away)): "Then you'll both be dead by morning, and I'll keep the house after all."
  1:34.00  SOUND_FX: His footsteps fade; a door clicks shut somewhere far off, then silence.
  1:36.50  CAMERA: Elena opens her hand. The brass key gleams. Behind her, unseen, Adrian watches from the study doorway — and his jaw tightens.
audit_note: The strongest line ('dead by morning') is followed by about 12s of footsteps, silence and a silent jaw-tighten reaction to close out. The cliff hinges on a performance beat, and the clip runs about 9s past the last scripted cue. Trim to end on Desmond's threat or the key gleam.
